annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and finite column-to-Frobenius formalization

assumptions: The common relative column coefficient eta is nonnegative.
Every backward-error column satisfies the same Euclidean relative bound against the corresponding input column.
Only the exact leading-order implication in (4.20) is selected; the paper's separate O(u^2) term is not represented.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P06 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P06 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p06_t1_columnwise_to_frobenius {m n : Nat} (A DeltaA : Fin m -> Fin n -> Real) (eta : Real) ... : p06FrobNorm DeltaA <= eta * p06FrobNorm A
formal_statement.plain_language: A common relative Euclidean bound for all error columns implies the same relative Frobenius bound for the complete error matrix.

informal_proof: Square each nonnegative column bound, sum over columns, identify the two sums with squared Frobenius norms, and take square roots using eta >= 0.
informal_statement: The deterministic columnwise-to-normwise implication displayed as equation (4.20).
